Table of where the indices stand

Source: R/fct_plots.R
overview_table.Rd

A table with a row per index of index_summary(), in the order of get_indices(): its region, last close and its date, the change on the day, this year and over a year, how far it is below its all-time high, that high and its date, the currency of its shares and the first day of its history. The changes are shaded red for falls and green for rises, each column on its own scale, as a day's moves are much smaller than a year's, and the distance from the high red, more strongly the further it is. Given the history, a column after the close draws the last year of each index as a small line (see sparkline_svg()).

Usage

overview_table(summary, indices = get_indices(), history = NULL)

Arguments

summary

The result of index_summary().

indices

Data frame of indices from get_indices(), for the regions and currencies.

history

The price history the summary was made from, for the lines of the last year, or NULL for none.

Value

A DT datatable.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
indices <- get_indices()
history <- get_history(indices$label[1:3], as.Date("1900-01-01"))
overview_table(index_summary(history), indices, history)
}
